subject: Renewal: LumenCo expansion tranche — pricing & timeline
messages:
From: Samantha King <sam.k@lumenco.io>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-27T09:12:00Z
Subject: Renewal request — expansion tranche + pricing ask

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for the quick chat yesterday. LumenCo is preparing our annual renewal and we have a near-term expansion: an additional 120 GPU hours/day (roughly 35% uplift on our current committed volume) tied to a new product pilot. Procurement asked me to put the ask in writing so you can share with pricing/finance.

High-level asks:
- Price hold for current base commit for 9 months while the pilot ramps (we cannot accept a mid-year price increase).
- A staged discount on the incremental expansion tranche — we were hoping for something in the ballpark of 10–15% on the first 6 months of the uplift.
- One-time onboarding/ingest credit to offset migration work (~$40k).

Attached is our renewal request packet and a simple MVP_commit_matrix.xlsx that shows expected ramp by week. We need a firm commercial outline by July 6 to align with our procurement window.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide a short-term price hold plus a staged discount on the expansion tranche? If yes, please send a mutual action plan and the items your legal team will need.

Thanks — appreciate your help.

Best,
Samantha King
Head of Platform Ops, LumenCo

+1 (415) 555-0187

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Date: 2027-06-29T08:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Renewal request — expansion tranche + pricing ask

Jordan / Ben — quick internal read and recommended commercial construct based on the attached ramp assumptions:

Summary recommendation (internal):
- Base commit: 9-month price hold at current per-token / per-embedding rates. No retroactive credits.
- Expansion tranche (first 6 months): incremental 12% discount on compute unit rate for the additional capacity (applied only to incremental usage above existing commit).
- Months 7–9 of the expansion tranche: step-down to 6% discount, with a standard true-up at contract anniversary.
- One-time onboarding credit: $45,000 applied as a contra-invoice credit (to cover initial ingress + ops).
- SLA: standard Dedicated SLA; no additional uptime credits for pilot.
- Legal: amendment + SOW for the pilot gating language; we recommend a 6-week termination window for the expansion tranche if pilot fails to reach 40% of forecasted volume by month 3.

Rationale: the price hold protects their base spend while the incremental discount incentivizes the pilot. The onboarding credit is within precedent for a mid-market expansion of this size. We should reserve an executive approval bucket for the credit (I can take it to finance).

Action items:
- Ben: please produce a redline of the amendment (pricing, credit apportionment, termination/gating).
- Jordan: ask procurement for PO timeline and confirm the procurement contact (we need DocuSign flow).
- I’ll draft the mutual action plan and the proposed pricing table for inclusion in the term sheet.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Attachment referenced internally: MVP_commit_matrix.xlsx

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Samantha King <sam.k@lumenco.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, procurement@lumenco.io
Date: 2027-06-30T10:27:00Z
Subject: Re: Renewal request — expansion tranche + pricing ask

Samantha / LumenCo procurement — thank you for the patience. Per our internal review, here is the commercial outline we can commit to in a term sheet:

Commercial summary (for procurement):
- Price hold: Current base commit rates held for 9 months from the effective date of the amendment.
- Expansion tranche: 12% discount on incremental usage for the first 6 months following the expansion go-live; months 7–9 step down to a 6% discount. Discounts apply only to incremental capacity above the existing committed baseline.
- Onboarding credit: $45,000 contra-invoice credit applied on first invoice after go-live.
- Pilot gating: if pilot does not reach 40% of forecasted incremental usage by the end of month 3, either party can elect to pause the expansion tranche with a 30-day notice; billing for already consumed incremental usage stands.
- Legal & deliverables: amendment to master services agreement + SOW. We will provide a DocuSign-ready amendment and a short mutual action plan.

We’ve attached the pricing table and a draft mutual action plan link here: https://docs.redwood.com/renewal-templates/lumenco-draft-v1 (also in HubSpot deal record). I’ll also attach the amendment draft for procurement review once Ben finishes his redline.

Proposed timeline:
- 2027-07-02: deliver term sheet + mutual action plan (we’ll aim earlier if Ben is done).
- 2027-07-06: LumenCo procurement provides PO intent (soft) or feedback.
- 2027-07-09 to 2027-07-12: DocuSign window for signature if PO is available.

Samantha — can you confirm procurement lead and whether DocuSign or your eProcurement connector is preferred?

Thanks — Jordan
